title: Attack log
description: Incident-level entries at the granularity operators actually receive them — a UKMTO warning, a ReCAAP weekly, an IMB PRC broadcast. This is a sample showing the shape of the real feeds, not a complete log. The complete logs are live at the sources named on each entry; see feeds below for how to pull them continuously.
coverage_note: Entries concentrated on 2026 because that is where the operational picture changed. Earlier named incidents with full ownership chains are in incidents.json.

entries.position: Approximately 105 nautical miles northeast of Aden
entries.attackers: 2 skiffs, unknown number of armed persons
entries.event: Vessel approached to within 4 metres and fired upon. Vessel deployed its security team and returned fire.

entries.position: Gulf of Aden, roughly midway between the Horn of Africa and Yemen
entries.event: Skiff approached and opened fire on the vessel with a rocket-propelled grenade.

entries.position: 14 nautical miles off the coast of Yemen
entries.event: Skiff approached, opened fire and attempted to board.

entries.position: Roughly midway between Yemen and the Horn of Africa
entries.event: Exchange of fire between the small craft and the vessel's armed security team, resulting in the craft turning away.
Vessel seized by Somali pirates. Still held as of the Joint Maritime Information Center advisory note of 16 June 2026, alongside vessels taken on 21 and 26 April 2026 — three held simultaneously.
Boarded and hijacked at anchor, then sailed with its 12 crew to the Somali coast.
No incident of piracy or armed robbery against ships in Asia reported over the week.

patterns_2026_h1.note: 38 reported incidents worldwide, the lowest first-half figure since 1992 — and the most misleading headline in this library. The breakdown below is why.
patterns_2026_h1.success_rate_note: Perpetrators boarded or hijacked in 32 of 38 incidents. When an approach is launched, shipboard barriers and detection routines are breached five times out of six.
patterns_2026_h1.attacks_at_anchor: 15 of the 32 successful attacks occurred while the vessel was anchored
patterns_2026_h1.target_note: Dry bulk and container together were 60% of targeted tonnage.

feeds.name: UKMTO warnings and advisories
feeds.format: PDF warnings, numbered per year (e.g. 071-26), plus JMIC advisory notes
feeds.area: Red Sea, Gulf of Aden, Indian Ocean, Arabian Sea
feeds.note: Also posts warnings to X as @UK_MTO, which is the fastest public channel.

feeds.name: IMB Piracy Reporting Centre live map
feeds.note: IMB PRC also broadcasts to shipping via GMDSS Safety Net and emails CSOs free of charge.

feeds.name: ReCAAP ISC weekly reports
feeds.format: PDF, one per week, plus quarterly, half-yearly and annual
feeds.note: Filenames follow a stable pattern, so the series is straightforward to fetch on a schedule. Includes nil-return weeks.

feeds.name: IMO GISIS piracy module
feeds.note: Incidents are promulgated here as soon as the Secretariat receives them from member states and reporting bodies.

feeds.name: MDAT-GoG
feeds.note: Operated by the French and UK navies. Registration required before entering the Voluntary Reporting Area. Does not coordinate responses to vessels under attack.
